# Crate Map

R2E is organized as a workspace of focused crates. The `r2e` facade crate re-exports everything with feature gates.

## Crate overview

Every publishable crate, with its current version. Crates are versioned independently;
each one has its own `CHANGELOG.md`.

| Crate | Version | Path | Description |
|-------|---------|------|-------------|

| `r2e-cache` | 0.6.0 | `r2e-cache` | TTL cache with pluggable backends for R2E - in-memory caching with expiration |

## Dependency flow

```
r2e-rt (async-runtime facade - sole tokio dependency)
r2e-tracing (process-global tracing subscriber - no tokio, no r2e deps)
    ^
r2e-http (HTTP abstraction - sole axum dependency)
    ^
r2e-macros (proc-macro, no runtime deps)
    ^
r2e-core (runtime foundation, re-exports r2e-http as `http` module)
    ^
r2e-security / r2e-events / r2e-executor / r2e-scheduler / r2e-grpc / r2e-tenant
    ^
r2e-mcp / r2e-data-sqlx / r2e-data-diesel / r2e-cache / r2e-rate-limit / r2e-openapi / r2e-utils
r2e-prometheus / r2e-observability / r2e-oidc / r2e-openfga / r2e-static
r2e-events-iggy / r2e-events-kafka / r2e-events-pulsar / r2e-events-rabbitmq
r2e-devtools / r2e-devservices / r2e-test
    ^
r2e (facade)
    ^
your application
```

> `r2e-grpc-build` is a build-dependency (build-script helper), not part of the
> runtime dependency graph. `r2e-openfga-model` and `r2e-openfga-macros` are
> internal to `r2e-openfga`. Event bus backends live under `r2e-events/backends/*`
> and the data backends under `r2e-data/backends/*`.

## Feature flags

The `r2e` facade crate gates sub-crates behind features.

**Default features:** `security`, `events`, `utils`

| Feature | Enables | In `full` | Notes |
|---------|---------|-----------|-------|
| `security` | r2e-security | yes | JWT/JWKS validation, `AuthenticatedUser`, roles (default) |
| `events` | r2e-events | yes | In-process `EventBus` (default) |
| `utils` | r2e-utils | yes | `Logged`, `Timed`, `Cache`, `CacheInvalidate` interceptors (default) |
| `data` | (nothing) | no | No-op compatibility marker: pagination (`Page`/`Pageable`) is always in core |
| `data-sqlx` | r2e-data-sqlx | no | Managed SQLx transactions + `DataSource` plugin (pick a driver below) |
| `data-diesel` | r2e-data-diesel | no | Managed Diesel transactions + `DataSource` plugin (pick a driver below) |
| `sqlx-sqlite` | data-sqlx, r2e-data-sqlx/sqlite | no | SQLx backend with this driver |
| `sqlx-postgres` | data-sqlx, r2e-data-sqlx/postgres | no | SQLx backend with this driver |
| `sqlx-mysql` | data-sqlx, r2e-data-sqlx/mysql | no | SQLx backend with this driver |
| `diesel-sqlite` | data-diesel, r2e-data-diesel/sqlite | no | Diesel backend with this driver |
| `diesel-postgres` | data-diesel, r2e-data-diesel/postgres | no | Diesel backend with this driver |
| `diesel-mysql` | data-diesel, r2e-data-diesel/mysql | no | Diesel backend with this driver |
| `tenant-sqlx` | tenant, data-sqlx, r2e-data-sqlx/tenant | no | Per-tenant SQLx pools / `TenantTx` |
| `tenant-diesel` | tenant, data-diesel, r2e-data-diesel/tenant | no | Per-tenant Diesel pools / `TenantTx` |
| `sqlite` | sqlx-sqlite | no | Compatibility alias; prefer the `sqlx-*` feature |
| `postgres` | sqlx-postgres | no | Compatibility alias; prefer the `sqlx-*` feature |
| `mysql` | sqlx-mysql | no | Compatibility alias; prefer the `sqlx-*` feature |
| `events-iggy` | events, r2e-events-iggy | no | Distributed event bus backend |
| `events-kafka` | events, r2e-events-kafka | no | Distributed event bus backend |
| `events-pulsar` | events, r2e-events-pulsar | no | Distributed event bus backend |
| `events-rabbitmq` | events, r2e-events-rabbitmq | no | Distributed event bus backend |
| `scheduler` | r2e-scheduler, executor | yes | Interval/cron `#[scheduled]` tasks (pulls in `executor`) |
| `scheduler-testing` | scheduler, r2e-scheduler/testing | no | Scheduler test helpers; enable from `[dev-dependencies]` only |
| `executor` | r2e-executor | yes | Managed task pool, `#[async_exec]`, background services |
| `cache` | r2e-cache | yes | `TtlCache` + pluggable `CacheStore` |
| `rate-limit` | r2e-rate-limit | yes | Token-bucket rate limiting |
| `oidc` | r2e-oidc | yes | Embedded OAuth/JWT issuer |
| `openapi` | r2e-openapi | yes | OpenAPI 3.1 generation + Swagger UI |
| `prometheus` | r2e-prometheus | yes | HTTP metrics + `/metrics` endpoint |
| `metrics-facade` | prometheus, r2e-prometheus/metrics-facade | no | HTTP metrics through the `metrics` crate (`MetricsFacade`); a stack choice |
| `openfga` | r2e-openfga | no | OpenFGA authorization (`model!`, `FgaCheck` guards) |
| `observability` | r2e-observability | yes | OpenTelemetry tracing + OTLP export |
| `grpc` | r2e-grpc, r2e-security?/grpc | yes | Tonic gRPC services |
| `mcp` | r2e-mcp | yes | MCP server (`#[tool]`/`#[resource]`/`#[prompt]`, `McpServer`) |
| `mcp-testing` | mcp, r2e-mcp/testing | no | MCP test helpers; enable from `[dev-dependencies]` only |
| `mcp-loopback` | mcp, r2e-mcp/loopback | no | In-process MCP sessions (`McpLoopback`) |
| `grpc-reflection` | grpc, r2e-grpc/reflection | yes | gRPC server reflection |
| `grpc-web` | grpc, r2e-grpc/web | yes | gRPC-Web |
| `static` | r2e-static | yes | Embedded static files / SPA |
| `tenant` | r2e-tenant | yes | Multi-tenant bean routing (`Tenanted<T>`, `Tenancy`) |
| `ws` | r2e-core/ws | yes | WebSockets |
| `multipart` | r2e-core/multipart | yes | Multipart form uploads |
| `json-sonic` | r2e-core/json-sonic | no | SIMD JSON codec (sonic-rs) behind `r2e::json` |
| `quic` | r2e-core/quic | no | HTTP/3 over QUIC (heavy crypto deps) |
| `dev-reload` | r2e-devtools, r2e-core/dev-reload | no | Subsecond hot-reload for `r2e dev`; never in production builds |
| `test-util` | r2e-core/test-util | no | Paused clocks for `#[r2e::test(start_paused = true)]` |

**`full`** enables exactly: `security`, `events`, `utils`, `scheduler`, `executor`, `cache`, `rate-limit`, `openapi`, `oidc`, `prometheus`, `observability`, `ws`, `multipart`, `grpc`, `grpc-reflection`, `grpc-web`, `static`, `tenant`, `mcp`.

Everything else is opt-in and deliberately left out of `full`: `data`, `data-sqlx`, `data-diesel`, `sqlx-sqlite`, `sqlx-postgres`, `sqlx-mysql`, `diesel-sqlite`, `diesel-postgres`, `diesel-mysql`, `tenant-sqlx`, `tenant-diesel`, `sqlite`, `postgres`, `mysql`, `events-iggy`, `events-kafka`, `events-pulsar`, `events-rabbitmq`, `scheduler-testing`, `metrics-facade`, `openfga`, `mcp-testing`, `mcp-loopback`, `json-sonic`, `quic`, `dev-reload`, `test-util`.
Database backends and drivers, distributed event-bus backends and OpenFGA are a
deployment choice; `quic` pulls heavy crypto dependencies; `dev-reload` and
`test-util` must never reach a production build; the `*-testing` features belong in
`[dev-dependencies]`.

## Using sub-crates directly

While most applications should use the `r2e` facade, you can depend on individual crates:

```toml
[dependencies]
r2e-core = "0.12"
r2e-macros = "0.13"
r2e-security = "0.13"
```

Because crates are versioned independently, the numbers differ from the facade's
(`r2e = "0.15"`). The proc macros use `proc-macro-crate` for dynamic path detection — they check for `r2e` first, then fall back to `r2e-core`. This means generated code uses `::r2e::` paths when using the facade, or `::r2e_core::` when using crates directly.
